title: DLRM L2-Pinning — Cross-Kernel L2 Reuse of Embedding Rows
summary_zh: MICRO'24 用三個純軟體技術加速 DLRM 推論的 EmbeddingBag gather-reduce kernel：OptMT（占用率調校，-maxrregcount 42）、RPF（kernel 內 register prefetch）、以及 L2P——一個獨立的前置 kernel 對 hot embedding row 發出 PTX prefetch.global.L2::evict_last，讓下一個 EmbeddingBag kernel 命中 L2。L2P 正是我們研究的跨 kernel L2-residency 機制。論文標題為最多 62% embedding / 48% e2e，但 L2P 在 RPF+OptMT 之上只增量約 13.5%，且原始碼確認計時器排除了 pin kernel 成本。本頁分析機制並記錄我們在 A100 上的 ablation 重現（進行中：build 編譯中、GPU run 排隊中，數字待補）。
summary_en: MICRO'24 accelerates the DLRM EmbeddingBag gather-reduce kernel with three software-only techniques: OptMT (occupancy tuning via -maxrregcount 42), RPF (in-kernel register prefetch), and L2P — a separate pre-kernel issuing PTX prefetch.global.L2::evict_last on hot embedding rows so the next EmbeddingBag kernel hits L2. L2P is exactly the cross-kernel L2-residency mechanism our study measures. Headline is up to 62% embedding / 48% e2e, but L2P adds only ~13.5% over RPF+OptMT, and the source confirms the timer excludes the pin-kernel cost. This page analyzes the mechanism and documents our A100 ablation reproduction (in progress: builds compiling, GPU runs queued, numbers pending).
